tip_repair_text: If you encounter missing or corrupted resource files, click the repair icon in the lower-right corner of the launcher loading screen. The program will exit and attempt to repair on the next startup.
repair_step1_text: Click the repair icon in the lower-right corner of the launcher loading screen. The program will automatically detect and fix missing or corrupted resource files.
repair_step2_text: After repair, a prompt window will appear. Click "OK" to exit the program. Restart QingFeng Launcher and the resource files will be fully restored.

game_intro_desc1: QingFeng is a visual novel game engine and cross-platform game launcher built with libGDX. The project adopts a standardized file structure and a JSON-driven resource system, organizing game content in a clear, consistent format to provide creators with a unified and stable runtime environment.
game_intro_desc2: The launcher natively supports three interface languages — Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English — along with a switchable theme system to suit users' individual preferences. It runs on Windows, Linux, and Android, covering both desktop and mobile use cases.
game_intro_desc3: QingFeng features a comprehensive resource pack management system, supporting the import and switching of language packs, theme packs, game language packs, and game theme packs, helping creators extend game content flexibly. Version checking and one-click resource repair ensure that game resources remain complete and usable at all times.
game_intro_desc4: Games and resource packs use dedicated file formats (.qfg, .qfl, .qft, .qfgl, .qfgt), registered across Windows, Linux, and Android, so you can load and run them directly with a double-click. Visual editors, 2D maps, and video playback are on the roadmap, opening up more possibilities for creators.
